data.definition: Resampling by area averaging (`Resample.area`): each output pixel is the mean of the input pixels it covers.
A rectangle of the screen, a view or a page that the code calls an area (a `CGRect`), such as the canvas's bounds inside the chrome.
An area the drawn lines enclose: book cells joined across edges with no line, what the painter reads as one shape (pbn's line-art metrics, `CellMap.mergeSmallWithinAreas`).
A line of text Vision found in the photo, as the box the writing stage reads and traces (`WritingAreaStats`, `Writing.find(in:areas:)`).
In the making-of show: a connected run of one paint in the show's palette picture, as against the merged region it ends up in (`FieldSteps`).

The painter's word for a region: one connected area of one paint, painted with one tap; what UI copy, VoiceOver, the painting screen and Refine call it (`paintArea`, `CanvasAreaElement`, `RefineAreaCard`).
A size: the square canvas units, pixels or points a shape, region, box or canvas covers (`Region.area`, `signedArea`, `minArea`, `maxCanvasArea`).
A coloring-book cell: a piece of paint the drawing's lines (or an undrawn cell edge) enclose, which becomes one template region; what Refine's Cells tools select, merge and reshape.
A square bin of a grid over the canvas or a picture: a pixel, a spatial-hash bucket, a lattice square of noise or of a test pattern; nothing to do with paint.
A slot of a laid-out table or sheet: a cell of the regression table, a tile of an eval or Auto sheet, a glyph's box in the digit atlas.
A region's paint as its index into `Template.palette` (`Region.colorIndex`); the number printed in the region is this + 1.
The hexadecimal digits of a color code: a palette color's `rrggbb` (`PaletteColor.hexDigits`) or a vocabulary line's.
A digit of a printed paint number: how many a number has and how they are measured, laid out and drawn (`LabelSizing.digitCount`, `digitAdvance`, `DigitAtlas`, `GlyphInstance.digit`).
In the app's making-of: each label's paint number, palette index + 1 (`MakingOfShow.digits`), and the text the view resolves for each.

Where a region's number is drawn: a `Template.Label` (position, free radius, region), the first at the region's pole, and the room, size, placement, moves and checks of it (`LabelSizing`, `LabelRoom`, `moveLabel`).

A region id in a label map: the per-pixel index a segmentation, a connected-components pass or the making-of's labeling gives each connected area (`Segmentation.labels`, `labelMap`, `RegionLabels`, `label_regions`).

A name text attached to a control, view, element or debug object: SwiftUI's `Label` and `label:` builders, VoiceOver's `accessibilityLabel` and `PaintSpeech`'s spoken labels, a Metal pass's or queue's label.

A paint number as printed in its region: its glyphs on the canvas, in pictures, the SVG and the making-of, where it sits, its size, ink, timing and whether it shows (`showsNumbers`, `numberColor`, `ShowTemplate.Number`, `moveNumber`).

A number in the everyday sense, not a paint's: a value read from a flag, spec, mailbox or JSON (`pbn`'s `number(_:_:)`, `ShowSpec.number`), an ordinal of a feedback mark, test move or area, JavaScript's `Number`.

A paint's number, its palette index + 1, by which regions, swatches, VoiceOver, the palette's order, Refine's cards and feedback reports name a paint (`PaintSpeech.colorLabel(number:)`, `FeedbackReport.Paint.number`, `selectedNumber`).
A paint number as set in New York on a swatch or the canvas: its ink, font and size (`PaletteBar.numeralInk`, `PaletteMetrics.numeralSize`, `DigitAtlas.numeralFont`).
A paint's number, palette index + 1, spelled out: what comments call it and what `RefineUITests.paintNumber(in:)` reads from an area card's label.
A paint's index into `Template.palette`, as comments and the shader's `w` name `Region.colorIndex`; no identifier is spelled so.
A flat swatch of one color in a picture: a test image's colored patch, a patch of photo or canvas a test averages.
The writing stage's window around one line of text, read on a finer raster than the canvas so small letters keep their shapes (`Writing.Patch`).
One area a drawn line or edge cuts a region into, before it becomes a region of its own (`EditWork.Piece`); a drawn line's paints are the photo's colors of these.
A connected bit of traced writing: a stroke between ends and junctions, or a dot (`WritingAreaStats.piecesPerHeight`, `Writing.maximumPieces`).
A stretch of a line, path or curve between cuts: what `pieces(keeping:)` keeps, an eraser leaves, a reshape moves or a curve is cut into.
The device's locale region (`Locale.Region`), which picks the paper a printed template is laid out for (`PDFExporter.Paper.default(for:)`).
In the making-of show and its Python reference: a connected run of one color in one of the show's pictures (`Labeling.regions`, `RegionLabels`), simplified or merged, timed by `regionTimes`.
One connected area of one paint: a label of the segmentation's region map and, in the template, an entry of `Template.regions` (rings, number, fill), the unit the painter paints and progress counts.
An array's dimensions: a NumPy array's or a Core ML tensor's `shape` (height, width, channels).
How a boundary edge's points were made, in the smoother's order of preference: drawn, faired, fitted, midpoints or lattice (`EdgeSmoother.Shape`).
The closed outline of a region or of an area lines close, as rings, polygons or a path (`RegionShapes`, `CreateModel.ClosedShape`, a mask's traced contours).
A figure Refine's Shapes tool draws as a line: a straight line, rectangle, oval, curve, hexagon or star (`RefineShape`, `ShapePath`).
In the retired crew show's Python planner: how far apart guardians' spots stay while both are there (`SPACE`).
Room on screen: the size a layout is offered, or a named coordinate space (`CompareView.fillsSpace`).
A color space: how encoded RGB maps to color (`RGBColorSpace`, sRGB or Display P3; Core Graphics' `CGColorSpace`).
One test's local name for the template's regions of one paint (`VectorizerTests`): the spots of a dotted test picture.
In the making-of show and its Python planner: a pixel drawn by weight and kept apart from the others, where a seed lands or a guardian worked (`Spot`, `Sampling`).

data.why: One concept, two names: the model and the pipeline say region (`Template.regions`, `PaintingSession`'s `region` indices); the UI copy, VoiceOver, the painting screen and Refine say area (`canvas-area-<region>`, `paintArea`).
In a coloring book each cell the lines enclose becomes one template region (`LineArtStats.cells == template.regions.count`); Refine's Cells tools and the canvas's hatch comments call regions cells.
`Region.colorIndex` is what comments and the shader call the palette index
`MakingOfShow.digits` holds each label's paint number (palette index + 1) under the name digits
one concept, two names: where a region's number is drawn is a `Label` in PaintCore, a `Number` in the making-of (`ShowTemplate.Number`, one per label) and Refine's Move Number (`.moveLabel`)
a numeral is a paint number as drawn in New York, on a swatch or the canvas
the same value spelled out: a paint's number, palette index + 1
A test's local name for a set of template regions.
